subject.title: fix(agent): treat Anthropic long-context usage errors as context overflow for compact+retry

question: Should this PR complete the compact-then-fallback contract before merge, or should maintainers accept compaction-only handling for this Anthropic long-context 429?
rationale: Both choices intentionally change provider routing and session-state behavior for existing Anthropic setups; the live maintainer review requested a failoverable terminal outcome that the branch still does not implement.

options.title: Complete Compact Then Fallback
options.body: Keep the classifier, then add a fallbackable terminal outcome only after bounded compaction and tool-result truncation are exhausted, with regression proof that the next configured candidate is selected safely.

options.title: Accept Classifier-Only Compaction
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept that this exact Anthropic 429 no longer uses configured model fallback after exhausted compaction, with docs tightened to that policy.

options.title: Hold For Broader Fallback Policy
options.body: Keep this PR open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9986 decides the generic post-overflow fallback contract.

recommendation.title: Complete Compact Then Fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the classifier, then add a fallbackable terminal outcome only after bounded compaction and tool-result truncation are exhausted, with regression proof that the next configured candidate is selected safely.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and authored the changes-requested review defining the unresolved compact-then-fallback shape.
